entries.wording: The parcel has returned to Sender

entries.note: The page prints this label where the posting date would be.

entries.wording: The shipment was delivered to the Recipient.
entries.note: A scan on the history page, which also words it "The shipment has been delivered to the recipient." The recipient's acknowledgement after it is not kept.

entries.wording: The shipment is processed at sorting center.
entries.note: A scan on the history page at a sorting centre on the way, at the hub and again at the delivery depot.

entries.wording: The recipient was informed about the date of delivery.
entries.note: A notice to the recipient on the history page before the delivery run; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Delivery in the way to the DHL Point
entries.note: A scan on the history page between the delivery depot and the DHL BOX locker or DHL POP point that then holds the parcel.

A scan on the history page naming the DHL BOX locker or DHL POP point that holds the parcel for its recipient, with its address and opening hours: "Shipment is waiting in Automat DHL BOX 24/7: <address> Opening hours: …".

entries.wording: Shipment collected from DHL Parcelstation. . Thank you!
entries.note: A scan on the history page after the parcel waited in a DHL BOX locker: its recipient collected it.
